items.name: Toffee's Brown Butter Espresso Crunch
items.description: Butter browned until it smells like toasted hazelnuts, espresso stirred straight into the dough, and a slab of soft toffee pressed into the center while the cookie is still hot. Dark chocolate melts into seams through the middle. Flaky salt on top, because it needs it.
items.texture: Craggy edges, dense chewy middle, a caramel center that stretches when warm.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy. Contains caffeine. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Classic Chocolate Chip
items.description: The one everything else gets measured against. Golden crisp rim, pale soft center, dark chocolate chips that stay glossy hours after the oven, and enough flaky salt that it never reads as just sweet.
items.texture: Crisp at the edge, soft and barely-set through the middle.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Coco's Double Chocolate Cookies & Cream
items.description: Dark cocoa dough, deep enough to stain your fingers, with crushed chocolate sandwich cookies folded through and white chocolate chips that go molten and creamy in the heat. A whole cookie set on top like she put it there herself. Named for the guinea pig who would absolutely take one if she could reach.
items.texture: Fudgy and brownie-dense, with cookie shards that stay crisp inside.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.

items.name: Cranberry White Chocolate Oatmeal, Orange Zest (Seasonal)
items.description: Old-fashioned oats and warm cinnamon underneath, dried cranberries that turn tart and jammy in the oven, white chocolate softening into the crumb, and fresh orange zest cutting clean through all of it. Here in the fall, gone by spring.
items.texture: Hearty and rustic, soft center, oats you can actually feel.
items.allergens: Contains wheat, milk, egg, soy, oats (not gluten-free). Dried cranberries may contain sulfites. Made in a home kitchen that also handles peanuts and tree nuts.
